2 Read the following passage, then answer the questions:

Books often connect the past with the present, but one book in the city of Prague did something even more remarkable. Many years ago, an old librarian named Mr. Novak discovered a dusty diary hidden behind a wooden shelf in a small library. The diary belonged to a young traveler who had crossed Europe in the nineteenth century. Instead
(5) of keeping it locked away, the librarian carefully preserved it and placed it among the library's rare collections.
Decades later, the library was modernized. Computers replaced card catalogs, and visitors could search for information with a single click. During the renovation, the diary was scanned and uploaded to a digital archive. Suddenly, people from different countries
(10) could read the traveler's experiences online. Historians used it to understand daily life in the past, while students enjoyed its exciting stories about castles, rivers, and ancient markets. One day, a teenager named Adam found the diary while searching the internet for a school project. He became fascinated by the traveler's adventures and decided to visit the same places described in the book. To his surprise, many landmarks still existed, although
(15) modern buildings now surrounded them. Adam realized that the diary was more than an old book; it was a bridge connecting two different centuries.
Today, the diary remains popular both in its original form and as a digital document. Its journey from a forgotten shelf to computer screens around the world reminds us that books can preserve memories, inspire new generations, and keep history alive in an ever-changing world.

The Bibliotheca Alexandrina is one of the most remarkable cultural landmarks in modern Egypt. Built near the site of the ancient Library of Alexandria, it serves as a powerful symbol of the connection between the past and the present. While the original library was one of the greatest centers of knowledge in the ancient world, the modern library continues its mission (5) by promoting education, research, and cultural exchange. As visitors enter the building, they are reminded that knowledge has always played a vital role in shaping civilizations.
The library is more than a place filled with books. It contains museums, exhibitions, digital collections, and research centers that attract scholars and visitors from around the world. By combining traditional learning with modern technology, the Bibliotheca Alexandrina (10) makes knowledge accessible to people of different ages and backgrounds. Its activities encourage curiosity, creativity, and lifelong learning.
In today's rapidly changing world, preserving knowledge has become increasingly important. Technology allows information to be stored and shared more easily than ever before. However, information alone is not enough. People must learn how to evaluate (15) sources, think critically, and distinguish facts from misinformation. Libraries continue to play an essential role in helping individuals develop these skills.
Ultimately, the Bibliotheca Alexandrina demonstrates that history is not something that belongs only to the past. The ideas, discoveries, and achievements of earlier generations continue to influence modern society. By learning from the past and building upon it, (20) people can create a brighter future. The library stands as a reminder that knowledge is a bridge connecting generations across time.

(6) الوحدة 4 | CONCEPT 4: Consumption and Choice | UNIT 4: The Power of Choice
==========================================================================================

◆ Unit Overview:
This unit explores the concept of consumption and choice through the different ways people consume from the brands on our clothes to the food we throw away, the sales that make us spend too much, and the screens we cannot put down. You will think about why we consume the way we do, and what it costs us and the world around us.
Through four lessons, you will read, listen, discuss, and write about consumption and start to think more carefully about your own habits as a consumer.

◆ Learning Objectives:
You will be able to:
Reading : Identify and explain the main causes and effects of food waste from a formal report, and distinguish between facts, opinions, and evidence within an argumentative text.
Listening : Extract specific information from an audio broadcast (e.g., The Food Waste Minute) to answer detailed questions.
Speaking : Discuss and debate topics related to consumer habits, such as food waste, brand culture, and digital consumption in pairs and small groups.
Writing : Write an opinion article supporting it with reasons, and a well-structured review evaluating (e.g. a book, device … etc.)

◆ Content Objectives | Language Objectives
الأهداف الخاصة بالمحتوى | الأهداف الخاصة بمهارات اللغة الإنجليزية
You will:
- understand how brands affect what we buy and how we see ourselves.
- identify the main causes of food waste at home and in schools.
- recognize the tricks used during sale events like Black Friday.
- reflect on how much time we spend on screens and what it costs us.
- give reasons for our opinions using JRE in all four.
You will:
- use the present perfect to talk about past actions that matter now.
- use linking words to connect ideas clearly in writing.
- use fronting to give emphasis in formal writing.
- write clear opinion paragraphs.

Topic overview          نظرة عامة علي الموضوع
Do you think people waste more food today than in the past?
Every year, a large amount of food is wasted around the world. This is because people buy more than they need, store food poorly, and misunderstand food labels. Food waste increases in houses, supermarkets, and during special times and festivals. However, simple actions such as better habits and awareness can help reduce this problem.
Inquiry Question:          سؤال بحثي
Where do you think most food waste happens: at home, at shops, or on farms? What do you think is the biggest reason for food waste in Egypt?
أين تعتقد أن معظم هدر الطعام يحدث: في المنزل، أم في المتاجر، أم في المزارع؟ ما هو في رأيك السبب الأكبر لهدر الطعام في مصر؟
Suggested answer:
Globally, food loss happens mostly on farms and during transport in developing regions, while shops and homes waste the most in wealthy nations. Locally, the main reasons for food waste in Egyptian homes are buying too much food, bad storage habits, and confusion about date labels.

◆ Reading Text
اقرأ القطعة ثم اجب عن الأسئلة للتدريب علي أسلبة قطعة الفهم.
Formal Report
The Causes of Food Waste in Egyptian Homes
Introduction:
This report looks at the main reasons why food is wasted in Egyptian homes. It uses information from consumer surveys and local studies. The results show that food waste in Egypt is a serious problem that needs to be addressed.
Project: What do you think the writer will say next about food waste?
Findings (Causes):
In Egypt, one common cause of food waste is buying more food than a family can use. During Ramadan, some families may prepare or purchase a large amount of food to welcome guests and express generosity. Although generosity is a positive and valued tradition, poor planning can sometimes lead to more food being prepared than needed. As a result, some of the extra food may be wasted.
Findings:
In Egypt, the most common cause of food waste is buying too much food. During Ramadan, many families buy more food than they need in one week. This is partly because offering a lot of food is seen as a sign of generosity(1). A second important cause is storing food incorrectly. Many homes do not have good refrigerators or dry storage(2). As a result, fresh food—especially bread, fruit, and vegetables—goes bad faster than it should. Bread waste alone is a very major issue in Egypt. A third cause is confusion about dates on food packages. Many people throw away food on or before its 'best before' date. However, 'best before' only means that the taste or quality might change—it does not mean the food is unsafe. The 'use by' date is the one that tells you when food is no longer safe to eat.
الكلم (1)
التخزين (2)

Discuss: Which cause of food waste seems most common in your community?
Recommendations:
Based on these findings, this report suggests three actions. First, schools should teach students about food shopping, and storage from an early age. Second, shops should be required to give leftover safe food(3) to food banks rather than throw it away. Third, food labels should be made clearer so that people understand the difference between 'best before' and 'use by'.
Evaluate: Which recommendation would have the biggest impact? Why?
Conclusion:
The evidence(4) shows that most food waste in Egypt can be reduced through education and better habits. These changes do not cost a lot of money. If these recommendations(5) are followed, the amount of food waste in Egyptian homes could go down significantly within a few years.
دليل (4)          بقايا الطعام السليمة (3)

◆ FOCUS on Vocabulary
لاحظ الفرق بين الكلمات التالية:
(1) leftover
يشير إلى الطعام أو الأشياء التي بقيت بعد استخدامها أو بعد وجبة.
We had some leftover rice from dinner.
remaining
يشير إلى أي شيء متبقٍ بعد استخدام أو إزالة جزء منه وليس بالضرورة طعاماً.
Adel used the remaining paper to draw a picture.
unused
يعني شيئاً لم يتم استخدامه إطلاقاً.
There are several unused notebooks on the shelf.
surplus
يشير إلى فائض أو كمية تزيد عن الحاجة، ويُستخدم كثيراً في الأعمال أو الزراعة أو الاقتصاد.
The farm sold its surplus vegetables to the market.
(2) storage
يشير إلى عملية أو مكان حفظ الأشياء لاستخدامها لاحقاً.
The building has enough storage for all the equipment.
warehouse
مبنى كبير يُستخدم لتخزين البضائع قبل بيعها أو توزيعها.
The company keeps its products in a warehouse.
storehouse
مكان مخصص لحفظ أو تخزين المواد أو الإمدادات، وغالباً يكون أصغر أو أكثر عمومية من warehouse.
The tools were kept in a storehouse behind the farm.

(3) require
يحتاج إلى أو يتطلب شيئاً آخر كي يكتمل أو ينجح.
The job requires strong communication skills.
acquire
يكتسب أو يحصل على شيء، مثل مهارة أو معرفة أو ممتلكات.
She acquired valuable experience during her internship.
inquire
يسأل أو يستفسبر عن معلومات.
He inquired about the train schedule at the station.
(4) habit
شيء تفعله بانتظام حتى يصبح جزءاً من روتينك.
Reading before bed is a good habit.
routine
سلسلة من الأنشطة المعتادة التي تتكرر كل يوم أو بشكل منتظم.
She follows the same morning routine every day.
custom
عادة أو تقليد تشترك فيه مجموعة من الناس أو مجتمع معين.
It is a custom to exchange gifts during the festival.
tradition
عادة أو ممارسة تنتقل من جيل إلى جيل.
Families often gather together as part of a long tradition.

B Grammar Focus

The Present Perfect Simple Tense زمن المضارع التام البسيط

Affirmative | الإثبات
Subject + (has/have) + P.P.
• Sara has completed her project successfully.
• They have visited many countries around the world.

Negative | النفي
Subject + (hasn't/haven't) + P.P.
• Omar hasn't finished his homework yet.
• We haven't seen our neighbors lately.

Question | السؤال
(Has/Have) + subject + P.P. + ...?
• Have they arrived at the airport yet?
Wh-word + (has/have) + subject + P.P. + ...?
• Where have you put my keys?

Passive | المبنى للمجهول
Object + (has/have) + been + P.P.
• Several trees have been planted in the park.

USAGE الاستخدام

(1) يعبرن حدث بدأ في الماضي وما زال مستمرا حتى الآن (مع for وsince).
• My father has worked for this company for fifteen years.
• We have known each other since primary school.

(2) يعبرن حدث بدأ وانتهى في الماضي لكن أثره في الحاضر.
أما إذا كان الأثر في الماضي ... فنستخدم الماضي التام.
• Nada is excited because she has won a competition.
• Nada was excited because she had won a competition.

(3) يعبرن حدث تم في الماضي دون ذكر متى حدث ( التكريريعكن على الحدث أما وقت الحدث ليس مهما ).
• He has read that novel three times.
• They have visited Aswan several times.
أما إذا تم تحديد زمنه نستخدم زمن الماضي البسيط.
• Adel bought a new cell phone yesterday.
مع الأحداث التاريخية المعروفة نستخدم زمن الماضي البسيط حتى لو لم يذكرمتى تم الحدث.
• The Romans built many roads across Europe.

(4) يعبرن حدث انتهى للتو (منذ فترة قصيرة) مع just.
• The manager has just signed the contract.

(5) للتحدث عن تجارب سابقة (دون ذكر متى حدث) مع never/ever.
• I have never ridden a horse.
• Have you ever flown in a helicopter?

(6) يعبرن حدث لم يحدث حتى الآن (متوقع حدوثه) مع yet.
• The train hasn't arrived yet.

(7) يعبرن حدث لم يحدث حتى الآن (غير متوقع حدوثه) مع never.
She has never failed an exam.

The present perfect simple is used with the following time expressions:

just | حالا | The baby has just fallen asleep.
already | بالفعل | We have already booked the tickets.
for | منذ/ لمدة | I have lived in Luxor for 10 years.
since | منذ | She has worked in this company since 2020.
in recent years | في الأونة الأخيرة | Technology has developed rapidly in recent years.
yet | حتى الآن (نفي/سؤال) | - Have you submitted the report yet? - Dalia hasn't done her task yet.
never | مطلقا/أبدا | He has never driven a truck.
over the years | على مر السنين | Scientists have made remarkable discoveries over the years.
in the last (past) few years | خلال السنوات الماضية | The city has expanded greatly in the last few years.
ever | من قبل | Have you ever tried Japanese food?
so far/up till now | حتى الآن | So far, our team has scored twenty goals.
lately/recently | حديثا | - He hasn't received any replies to his job applications lately. - I have recently started learning Spanish.
throughout history | عبرالتاريخ | People have used maps throughout history.

FOR & SINCE

for | a day/a week/a month/a year
for | days/weeks/months/years
for | ... hours
for | a long time
for | ages
for | the last + مدة زمنية
for | a season
for | a while/a fortnight
for | a decade/a century
for | as long as I can remember

since + | Saturday/Monday/Friday
since + | 2020
since + | ... o'clock
since + | then منذ ذلك الحين
since + | his childhood/her marriage
since + | last + جملة / the last + مدة زمنية
since + | summer/spring
since + | ago + مدة زمنية
since + | the age of + ...
since + | verb + ing

◆ Topic overview | نظرة عامة على الموضوع
How do companies influence consumers using "brand culture"?
Every day, teenagers are surrounded by brands, from the moment they wake up until they go to sleep. These brands are not just simple logos on products. They are carefully designed to influence how people think and feel. Companies use powerful ideas and emotions to connect their products to identity and belonging. This raises an important question: when we choose a brand, are we making our own decisions, or are our choices being shaped for us?
Inquiry Question: سؤال بحثي
What is the difference between a product and a brand?
ما الفرق بين المنتج والعلامة التجارية؟
Suggested answer:
A product is something you make and sell to solve a problem, like a pair of shoes. A brand is the name, style, and reputation of that company, which makes people trust it and choose it over others.

◆ Reading Text
اقرأ القطعة ثم اجب عن الأسئلة للتدريب على أسلبة قطعة الفهم.
More Than a Logo: How Brands Shape What We Buy
Every day, by the time most teenagers in Egypt have had breakfast, they have already made more brand choices than they realize. The phone that wakes them up is one of the most recognized devices(1) in the world. The shoes by the door carry a tick that is far more famous than the company's actual name. Furthermore, the cereal box on the table features(2) a cartoon bird that has remained unchanged longer than many brands have survived(3). None of this is an accident. The biggest companies invest more heavily in brand-building(4) than in almost anything else. This is because a well-known brand is more valuable than any single product. In addition, they spend more on emotional storytelling than on simply describing what their products do. A brand is much more than a logo. It is a set of feelings and ideas, and the strongest brands build those feelings more carefully and more consistently(5) than smaller companies ever could. When brand X puts its tick on a shoe and writes "Just Do It", it is selling not only shoes, but also the idea that the person who wears them is stronger, more determined, and more ready for a challenge than someone who does not. Similarly, when a brand phone presents a new phone in a clean white room, it is selling the idea that its products are simpler, more elegant, and more desirable(6) than anything else on the market. A branded product is almost always more expensive than a similar unbranded one. Even though the quality difference is often smaller than people expect, they still choose the brand because the feeling it gives them feels worth far more than the price difference.
(1) أجهزة/معيدات | (2) يعرض
(3) بقي/نجا | (4) صناعة العلامة التجارية
(5) بصورة منتظمة | (6) مرغوب

(7) عملي | (8) استهلاك
(9) ومن المعترف به
Psychologists who study how people make choices have found something interesting. When people see the logo of their favorite brand, the part of the brain linked to personal identity becomes more active than when they see an unknown label. As a result, choosing a brand is rarely a simple or purely practical(7) decision. This means that when someone chooses X over Z, they are often making a deeper choice than simply picking a more comfortable shoe—they are saying something about who they are, or who they most want to be. Understanding why we prefer one brand to another can be an important step towards mindful consumption(8). For instance, for many young people in Egypt, wearing the most popular brand feels more important than wearing the most practical one, because brands have become one of the most powerful languages we use to show where we belong. Admittedly(9), not everyone is equally influenced by brand image.
Although companies benefit greatly from this power, the influence of brands also raises one of the most important questions in modern life: are we truly free when we make choices, or do companies create our preferences for us? On the other hand, understanding how brands work gives us a real advantage as consumers. This helps us avoid blind brand loyalty, where we buy a product based on emotion rather than quality. The most successful brands do not just sell products. They sell the feeling of belonging somewhere. Consequently, this feeling becomes stronger, far more personal. It also becomes harder to resist than any simple advertisement could ever be. Overall, the more aware we are of how brands shape our thinking, the better and freer our choices can become.
Source
"Synthesized and adapted by the national curriculum development team from modern neuromarketing literature, cognitive identity psychology regarding brand-logo brain activation, and consumer sociology frameworks on modern mindful consumption habits."

B Grammar Focus

◆ Important Notes
1 إذا جاء مع (since) فعل واحد في الجملة يوضع في زمن المضارع التام البسيط أو المستمر.
(بداية الفترة الزمنية) since (مضارع تام بسيط/ مستمر)
إذا جاء مع (since) فعلين ... أي يملت بين جملتين تصبح القاعدة كالآتي:
(ماضي بسيط) + (فعل) since (مضارع تام بسيط/ مستمر)
• My uncle has worked here since 2018.
• We haven't seen Ali since he was in Alex.
• We have stayed friends since we graduated from university.
2 تستخدم for مع زمن الماضي البسيط إذا تم التوضيح في الجملة أن الحدث انتهى ولم يعد له أثر.
• Kareem worked in that factory for eight years. Now, he owns his own business.
3 تستخدم already للتعبير عن الدهشة في نهاية الجملة الاستفهامية.
• Have they left already? That's surprisingly quick.
4 تستخدم never مع صفات المقارنة وever مع التفضيل.
• She has never written a more interesting article than the last one.
• This is the most interesting article she has ever written.
5 يستخدم المضارع التام مع:
(This's/It's) the (first/second/last/ ...) time
• It's the first time I have spoken in front of a large audience.
6 يستخدم المضارع التام مع:
today/this ... (morning/evening/week/month/year)
• I have attended three meetings this week.
أما في حالة وجود earlier قبل التعبيرات السابقة فتستخدم الماضي البسيط، إذا كانت الفترة الزمنية انتهت بالنسبة للمتكلم أو إذا كان المقصود وقتًا محددًا.
• I attended three meetings earlier this week.
7 يستخدم المضارع التام مع:
How long + (has/have) + فاعل + P.P. + for? | How long have you lived in Alex for?
For how long + (has/have) + فاعل + P.P.? | For how long have you lived in Alex?
Since when + (has/have) + فاعل + P.P.? | Since when have you lived in Alex?
8 يستخدم المضارع التام مع الروابط الزمنية التالية:
when
as soon as
once
after | before
until
by the time
مضارع بسيط/ مضارع تام | جملة أمرية/ أمر + أزمنة المستقبل
• Once you have submitted the application, you will receive a confirmation email.
• I won't start the meeting until everyone has arrived.

لحظة الفروق
have been (to)/have gone (to)/have been (in/at)
have been (to) | ذهب إلى مكان وعاد | - Where have you been, Ramy?
have gone (to) | ذهب إلى مكان ولم يعد | - Where has Mona gone? I can't find her.
have been in/at | ذهب إلى مكان واستقر فيه | - He has been in Alex for 25 years.
for the last + (مدة زمنية)
since last + (مدة زمنية)
• I haven't met Ali for the last week.
• I haven't met Ali since last week.
أما إذا لم يأت بعدها مدة زمنية فتستخدم since.
• I haven't met Ali since the last meeting.

Extra Points

1 عند استخدام (since) بدلا من (for) :

It's/It has been + (المدة الزمنية) + since + (subj.) + last + (ماضي بسيط)
(Subj.) + (has/have) + not + (P.P.) + for + (المدة الزمنية)

I haven't visited Alex for a long time. (since)
→ It's a long time since I last visited Alex.
It's a year since she last traveled abroad. (for)
→ She hasn't traveled abroad for a year.

لاحظ تحويل الماضي البسيط إلى المضارع التام المنفي والعكس.

2 عند استخدام (since) بدلا من (when) ... أو العكس :

(Subj.) + (hasn't/haven't) + (P.P.) + ... + since + (subj.) + (ماضي بسيط) + ....
(Subj.) + last + (ماضي بسيط) + ... + when + (subj.) + (ماضي بسيط) + ....

I haven't met Ali since we were in Alex. (when)/(last)
→ I last met Ali when we were in Alex.
He last played football when he was 20 years old. (since)
→ He hasn't played football since he was 20 years old.

3 عند استخدام (yet) بدلًا من (still) .... والعكس :

(Subj.) + (am/is/are) + still + (v + ing) + ...
(Subj.) + (hasn't/haven't) + (finished/stopped) + (v + ing) + ... + yet

He is still studying English. (yet)/(finished)
→ He hasn't finished studying English yet.
I haven't stopped smoking cigarettes yet. (still)
→ I'm still smoking cigarettes.

4 عند استخدام (ago) بدلا من (for) OR (since) .... والعكس :

(Subj.) + (began to/started to) + inf. + .... + (المدة الزمنية) + ago

I have lived in Alex for 10 years. (ago)
→ I began to live in Alex 10 years ago.

5 عند استخدام (The last time) بدلا من (since) OR (for) .... والعكس :

The last time + (subj.) + (الماضي البسيط) + .... + (was) → in + (تاريخ)
→ (مدة زمنية) + ago

(Subj.) + (hasn't/haven't) + (P.P.) → since + (بداية الحدث)
→ for + (مدة زمنية محددة)

I haven't played football since 2024. (The last time)
→ The last time I played football was in 2024.
→ The last time I played football was 2 years ago.
The last time I saw her was 2 months ago. (for)
→ I haven't seen her for 2 months.

6 عند استخدام (just) بدلًا من : (a moment ago) OR (a short time ago) OR (just now) أو العكس :

(Subj.) + (has/have) + just + (P.P.) + ...
(Subj.) + (ماضي بسيط) + .... (a moment ago & a short time ago & just now)

I have just cooked the food. (a moment ago)
→ I cooked the food a moment ago.
She cleaned the room just now. (just)
→ She has just cleaned the room.

7 عند استخدام (ever) بدلا من (never) ... أو العكس :

It's the first time + (subj.) + (has/have) + ever + (P.P.) + ....
(Subj.) + (has/have) + ever + (P.P.) + .... + before

I have never traveled to Luxor before. (ever)
→ It's the first time I have ever traveled to Luxor.
It's the first time she has ever cooked food. (never)
→ She has never cooked food before.

نظرة عامة على الموضوع | Topic overview

How apps use your time.
Many teenagers use social media every day without thinking about how these apps really work. Although these platforms seem free, they actually collect information about users' behavior and interests. Apps are carefully designed to keep people online longer through features that make it hard to stop scrolling. While social media has benefits, it is important for users to understand how their time and attention are being used.

سؤال بحثي | Inquiry Question:
How do social media apps encourage people to spend more time online?
كيف تشجع تطبيقات التواصل الاجتماعي الأشخاص على قضاء المزيد من الوقت على الإنترنت؟

Suggested answer:
Social media apps keep you online longer using infinite scrolling that removes stopping points, personalized feeds fitted to your interests, surprise rewards that keep you curious, and push notifications that pull you back into the app.

◆ Listening Text
Scan & listen

How apps use your time

1. You have probably heard this phrase before
If you are not paying for the product, you are the product.' Most people use social media apps for free(1). But nothing is ever truly free. Every minute you spend scrolling, the app is collecting data about you — what you like, what you ignore(2), how long you stop on each image, and what makes you react. This data is then sold to companies who want to show you advertisements. Your time and attention are not free, they are being bought and sold.

2. Apps are designed to keep you online for as long as possible.
Features like infinite(3) scroll — where the feed never ends — and autoplay — where the next video starts automatically — were not created by accident. They were built by teams of designers and professionals(4) whose job was to make you stay on the app. By the age of 17, the average(5) teenager has already spent more time on social media than in all their years of school.

3. The effects on concentration are also serious.
Research has found that simply receiving a notification(6) — even if you do not open it — can make it harder to focus on a task. Your brain is waiting for the reward of checking the message, and this waiting takes up mental energy(7). Students who keep their phones nearby while studying perform less well than those who put their phones in another room.

(1) مجانًا | (2) يتجاهل
(3) لانهائي | (4) محترفون
(5) متوسط | (6) إشعار
(7) قدرة ذهنية

4. How such platforms work.
None of this means that apps and social media are completely bad.
They help people stay connected, access information, and be creative(8).
However, it is important to understand how these platforms work — and
who benefits from your time online. The first step to being in control of your digital habits is simply knowing that your attention has a value(9). Companies have always known this. Now it is time for users to know it too.

(8) مبدع
(9) قيمة

B Grammar Focus
The Present Perfect Continuous Tense
زمن المضارع التام المستمر
Affirmative الإثبات | Subject + (has/have) + been + v-ing
• He has been studying English all evening.
Negative النفى | Subject + (hasn't/haven't) + been + v-ing
• They haven't been sleeping all night.
Question السؤال | (Has/Have) + subject + been + v-ing?
• Have you been training all afternoon?
• How long have you been studying your lessons?
The present perfect continuous is used with the following time expressions:
(for & since & all + مدة زمنية & how long)
1 يعبر عن حدث بدأ في الماضي ومازال مستمراً وخاصة مع التعبيرات الزمنية السابقة .
• It has been raining since 2 o'clock.
2 حدث بدأ وأنتى في الماضي (ولكنه كان مستمراً في الماضي) وأثره موجود في الحاضر.
Marwan is very tired. He has been studying his lessons all day.
3 تفسير موقف في الوقت الحاضر.
I have been training hard, so I'm very tired.

◆ Important Notes
1 لا يستخدم زمن المضارع التام المستمر مع الإعداد وعدد المرأت ونستخدم المضارع التام البسيط.
(✗) I have been drinking 5 cups of coffee.
(✓) I have drunk 5 cups of coffee.
2 لا يستخدم زمن المضارع التام المستمر مع stative verbs ونستخدم المضارع التام البسيط.
(✗) Mona has been owning a car for five years now.
(✓) Mona has owned a car for five years now.
3 يستخدم المضارع التام المستمر مع الأفعال التي تستغرق وقتاً طويلاً في الحدوث مثل :
wait – travel – read – sleep – stay – mend – swim – stand – repair – rain – cook – play
– run – write – sit – live – work – teach – learn – study
• He has been playing football for 3 hours now.
4 لا يوجد فرق في المعنى إذا تم استخدام زمن المضارع التام البسيط أو المستمر مع بعض الأفعال مثل:
live – work – teach – learn – study
• He has lived/has been living in Alexandria since 2020.

5 من ملاحظات زمن المضارع التام المستمر :
for ... now & for ... still & so far ... now & since ... still
I have been studying English literature for a year now.
6 نستخدم المضارع التام البسيط وليس المستمر مع How much/How many
How much money have you had?
How many books have you read?

◆ Topic overview | نظرة عامة على الموضوع
The Psychology of the Sale: Why We Buy What We Do Not Need
Sale events make people feel excited and believe they are saving money! However, companies use clever tricks to influence our decisions and push us to buy more. These tricks create urgency and make products seem more valuable than they really are. In the end, many people spend more than they planned, even when they think they are saving.
Inquiry Question: | سؤال بحثي
In the Egyptian market, we see both terms: "Black Friday" and "White Friday". Why do you think some brands choose one over the other? How does the name influence your decision?
في السوق المصرية نرى كلا المصطلحين: «الجمعة السوداء» و«الجمعة البيضاء». لماذا تعتقد أن بعض العلامات التجارية تختار واحدة على الأخرى؟ كيف يؤثر الاسم على قرارك؟
Suggested answer:
In Egypt, some brands use "Black Friday" because it is a famous global shopping day. Other brands use "White Friday" to respect local and religious traditions, making the event feel more friendly for families. However, the name does not change a buyer's choice. People buy things based on real discounts, clear prices, and useful products, not because of the color in the name.
اقرأ القطعة ثم اجب عن الأسئلة للتعزيز على اسللة قطعة الفهم.

◆ Reading Text
The Tricks Behind Sale Events
Every year, millions of people around the world wait for events like Black Friday to go shopping. They feel excited as they plan their purchases(1) in advance and they believe they are making smart choices(2). But are they really saving money, or are they falling for a set of(3) very clever tricks?
What happens to the jacket price in the example?
One of the most common tricks is called loss aversion(4). Imagine a jacket that costs 400 Egyptian pounds. You do not really need it. Then a sign(5) appears: 'Was 800 LE, Now 400 LE, Save 50%!' Suddenly, the jacket feels much more attractive. Your brain tells you: 'If I don't buy it, I will lose the chance to save 400 pounds.' Of course, you have not lost anything, but that is how our brains work. Not buying something feels like a loss(6).
Name two tricks used in sales.
Sale events also use other tricks. Phrases like 'Only 3 left in stock!(7)' create a feeling of urgency, you feel that you must decide immediately or miss the chance. When you see many other people buying something, you think it must be a good idea. And countdown clocks on websites force you to decide quickly, before you have time to think carefully. All three tricks work together to push you towards buying.
(1) مشتريات | (2) اختيارات ذكية
(3) مجموعة من | (4) كراهية الخسارة
(5) علامة | (6) خسارة
(7) متوفر في المخزن

Do you think people really save money during sales? Why/Why not?
Research has found something surprising: people who shop during sales(8) actually spend more money overall than people who do not. They feel they have saved money, but in fact they have spent more. The sale is not designed to save you money. It is designed to make you spend more and feel happy about it.
(8) عروض
Source
"Synthesized and adapted by the national curriculum development team from behavioral economics, specifically Daniel Kahneman and Amos Tversky's cognitive framework of 'loss aversion', consumer retail psychology, and spending trend analytics, scaffolded to model the present perfect tense."

deceive
خداع شخص وإعطاؤه فكرة غيرصحيحة.

mislead
يضلل شخصًا ويجعله يفهم شيئًا بطريقة خاطئة.

1 | cheat
يفشل / غش أوتصرف بطريقة غيرعادلة للحصول على فائدة.
He cheated in the exam.

عملية احتيال تهدف إلى الحصول على المال أو المعلومات.

prank
مقلب أو خدعة للمزاح وليس للإضرار بالآخرين.

miss

I missed the chance to buy the ticket.
lose
يفقد شيئًا كان يمتلكه أو يخسر مباراة أو منافسة.

neglect
يهمل شيئًا أو لا يعطيه الاهتمام الكافي.

(3) force

power
القدرة على التحكم أو التأثير أو تشغيل شيء. السلطة والنفوذ.

energy
١ – القوة أو الموارد الطبيعية التي يمكن استغلالها لتوليد الطاقة.

ضغط يأتي من الخارج، مثل الدراسة أو الأسرة أو الوقت، ويجعلك تشعر أنك يجب أن تفعل شيئًا. ضغط الهواء – ضغط الدم

◆ B | Grammar Focus
Present Perfect and Past Simple
المضارع التام والماضي البسيط
• يستخدم كلا الزمنين للحديث عن أحداث انتهت، ولكن الفرق بينهما هو :
Present Perfect Tense | Past Simple Tense
زمن المضارع التام | زمن الماضي البسيط
يستخدم لحدث انتهى وهله علاقة بالحاضر. | يستخدم لحدث انتهى وليس له علاقة بالحاضر.
Sara has baked some cookies. They are still warm. | Sara baked some cookies yesterday.
Ali has lost his wallet. He is looking for it now. | Ali lost his wallet last Friday.
We have visited the museum several times. | We visited the museum during our school trip.
Mona has worked at this company for three years. (She still works there.) | Mona worked at that company for three years. (She doesn't work there now.)

Present Perfect Simple and Continuous
المضارع التام البسيط والمستمر
• كلا الزمنين يستخدمان للتحدث عن أحداث بدأت في الماضي ولا علاقة بالحاضر لكن الفرق بينهما هو أن المضارع التام البسيط يركز على النتيجة، بينما المضارع التام المستمر يركز على مدة أو استمرار الحدث.

Present Perfect Simple
يستخدم عند اكتمال الفعل.
has/ have + P.P.
Sara has painted the living room.
The students have finished the project.
I have cleaned my room. (The room is clean now.)
She has cooked dinner. (Dinner is ready.)
يركز على النتيجة أو الإنجاز.

Present Perfect Continuous
يستخدم عندما يكون الفعل مستمرًا أو انتهى منذ وقت قصيرولآثاره واضحة.
has/ have been + v-ing
Ahmed has been studying for three hours.
It has been raining since early morning.
I have been cleaning my room for two hours. (Focus on the duration.)
She has been cooking dinner for an hour. (Focus on the activity.)
يركز على مدة أو استمرار الفعل.

الحظ: لا يستخدم المضارع التام المستمر مع stative verbs أفعال الحالة.

Common Mistakes | أخطاء شائعة
I have been knowing him for ten years. X
I have known him for ten years. ✓
She has been loving music since childhood. X
She has loved music since childhood. ✓

Language in Context
Fronting | التقديم
• In normal English sentences, we usually start with the subject, then the verb, and finally the rest of the sentence.
في الجمل الإنجليزية العادية، نبدأ عادةً بالفاعل، ثم الفعل، وأخيراً بقية الجملة.
Subject + Verb + Rest of sentence ترتيب الجملة الطبيعي
• When we use Fronting, we move a phrase (like a time, place, cause, or contrast phrase) to the very beginning of the sentence, followed by a comma (,).
عندما نستخدم التقديم، فإننا ننقل العبارة (مثل الزمان أو المكان أو السبب أو التباين) إلى بداية الجملة، متبوعة بفاصلة (,).
Fronted Phrase + , + subject + verb + ... جملة التقديم
Types of Fronting (أنواع التقديم)
1 | Fronting a Time/Place Phrase | (تقديم شبه جملة تدل على الزمان أو المكان)
• We move the place or time to the front because we want the reader to know where or when the action happens immediately.
• ننقل المكان أو الزمان في أول الجملة لكي نلفت انتباه القارئ فوراً لمكان أو وقت حدوث الفعل.
Normal Sentence | Fronted Sentence
Food waste is a serious problem in Egypt. | In Egypt, food waste is a serious problem.
I study English in my bedroom. | In my bedroom, I study English vocabulary.
2 | Fronting a Result/Cause Phrase | (تقديم شبه جملة تدل على السبب أو النتيجة)
• We move the cause or the result to the front to show the connection between two ideas right away. Words like (Because of, As a result of, Due to) are used here.
نضع السبب أو النتيجة في مقدمة الجملة لإظهار الصلة بين الفكرتين على الفور.
Normal Sentence | Fronted Sentence
Bread goes bad quickly as a result of poor storage. | As a result of poor storage, bread goes bad quickly.
I missed my morning train because of the heavy rain. | Because of the heavy rain, I missed my morning train.

3 | Fronting for Contrast | (تقديم شبه جملة تدل على التباين/المقارنة)
• We move the contrast phrase to the front to emphasize how two things are completely different. Words like (Unlike, In contrast to) are used here.
• ننقل شبه جملة التباين أو الاختلاف في الأول لكي نوضح للمصحح أو القارئ أننا نقارن بين شيئين مختلفين تماماً من بداية الجملة.
Normal Sentence | Fronted Sentence
Egypt wastes most food at home, unlike richer countries. | Unlike richer countries, Egypt wastes most food at home.
My brother loves playing football, unlike me. | Unlike me, my brother loves playing football.
لاحظ يا ذكا:
• When you pull a phrase to the front of the sentence, you MUST put a comma (,) after it before you write the subject.
• Correct: In advance, we booked the tickets.
• Incorrect: In advance we booked the tickets.
An Opinion Article
مقال الرأي وهو مقال يعبر فيه الكاتب عن رأيه في موضوع معين مع تقديم أسباب وأمثلة تدعم هذا الرأي.
Structure of an Opinion Article
مكونات مقال الرأي
1. Headline: a short, catchy title that shows your opinion
عنوان قصير وجذاب يوضح رأيك.
2. Introduction: give the topic and state your main opinion clearly
المقدمة: قدم الموضوع واذكر رأيك الرئيسي بوضوح.
3. Body paragraph 1: first reason + example or evidence
الفقرة الأولى من النص: اذكر السبب الأول + المثال أو الدليل.
Useful expressions:
تعبيرات مفيدة تستخدم لتوضيح الرأي
Nowadays, ... / In recent years, ... / There is a lot of debate about ...
In my opinion, ... / I strongly believe that ... / I believe that ...
4. Body paragraph 2: second reason + example or evidence
الفقرة الثانية من النص اذكر السبب الثاني + المثال أو الدليل.
5. Concession: mention one point from the other side
الرأي الآخر: قم بذكر نقطة واحدة من الرأي الآخر.
هنا تظهر لنا تعرف أن هناك وجهة نظر أخرى.
Useful expressions:
تعبيرات مفيدة تستخدم لعرض الرأي الآخر
Some people argue that.../ It is true that.../ Although.../ However, .../ Nevertheless, .../
On the other hand, ...
6. Conclusion: restate your opinion and end with a strong final sentence
الخاتمة: أعيد صياغة رأيك واختم بجملة أخيرة قوية.
Useful expressions:
تعبيرات مفيدة تستخدم لعرض الخاتمة
In conclusion, ..,/ To sum up, ..,/ All in all, ..,/ For these reasons, .../ I believe that .../ In my view, ...

A Model Paragraph
Is Social Media Good for Teenagers?
Nowadays, social media plays an important role in teenagers' lives. In my opinion, using social media wisely can have many benefits. First of all, social media helps teenagers communicate with their friends and family. For example, they can easily stay in touch with people who live far away. Secondly, social media can help students learn new things. They can follow educational pages, watch useful videos and share information with other students. Some people argue that social media wastes teenagers' time. Although this can happen, I believe that the problem is not social media itself but the way people use it. In conclusion, social media can be useful for teenagers if they use it responsibly. For these reasons, I believe that its benefits can be greater than its disadvantages.
A Review | المراجعة/التقييم
- A type of article where you describe the main features of a product, book, or experience, explain its good and bad points, and help the reader decide whether to buy or try it.
• هو نوع من المقالات تقدم فيه وصف الميزات الأساسية لمنتج أو كتاب أو تجربة معينة، وتوضح نقاطها الإيجابية والسلبية، لتساعد القارئ في اتخاذ القرار هل يشترى هذا الشيء أو يجربه أم لا.
Structure of a review مكونات المقال المنقدي
1 | Headline العنوان الرئيسي | A short, catchy title that immediately shows your opinion. عنوان قصير وجذاب يوضح رأيك من أول كلمة.
2 | Introduction المقدمة | Introduce the general topic and state your main opinion clearly in the last sentence. قدم الموضوع العام، واكتب رأيك الرئيسي في الجملة الأخيرة.
3 | Body Paragraph 1 الفقرة الأولى | Give your first reason backed up with a real-world example. قدم السبب الأول وادعمه بمثال واقعي لإقناع المصحح.
4 | Body Paragraph 2 الفقرة الثانية | Give your second reason with another example or evidence. قدم السبب الثاني مع مثال آخر خبثت ووصية نظرتك.
5 | Concession الاعتراف بالرأي الآخر | Mention one fair point from the opposing side, then show why your opinion is still stronger. اذكر نقطة عادلة (منطقة) من الجانب المعارض، ثم بين لماذا يبقى رأيك هو الأقوى.
6 | Conclusion الخاتمة | Restate your main opinion using different words and end with a strong sentence. أعد تأكيد رأيك بكلمات جديدة، واختم المقال بجملة قوية تترك في ذهن المصحح.

MODEL REVIEW ESSAY
Smartphones in Schools: A Digital Disaster for Learning!
Introduction | Cell phones are now everywhere in our daily lives. While they are useful tools for communication, I strongly believe that smartphones should be completely banned during school hours to protect students.
Body Paragraph 1 | To begin with, phones cause severe harm to students' mental concentration. For example, when a digital notification pops up on تظهر a teenager's screen during an English class, their attention immediately shifts away from the lesson.
Body Paragraph 2 | Furthermore, banning phones encourages healthier social behavior among teenagers. In daily life, when students do not have screens to scroll through during breaks, they actually talk to each other and build real friendships.
Concession | Of course, some people argue that smartphones are necessary for students to contact their parents in case of emergencies. However, families can easily contact the school administration office to reach their children immediately.
Conclusion | In conclusion, it is clear that classrooms should be phone-free zones. Removing these digital distractions is the best decision to improve overall student focus and academic success.

2 Read the following passage, then answer the questions:
For many years, people believed that being overweight was a sign of good health and prosperity. Today, however, most doctors and health experts disagree with this idea. Obesity is now considered a major health concern because it increases the risk of several serious diseases, including heart disease, diabetes, and high blood pressure. As a result, 5 many people are trying to lose weight and maintain a healthy lifestyle. Researchers have conducted numerous studies to understand why some people gain excessive weight and what factors influence appetite.
Recent studies have shown that appetite is controlled by both emotional and biochemical factors. Emotional factors include feelings such as stress, anxiety, sadness, and boredom. 10 For example, researchers found that many people tend to eat more when they are under stress. Further experiments involving both humans and animals revealed an interesting fact: it is not necessarily the food itself that reduces tension, but rather the act of chewing. This suggests that eating can provide psychological comfort during difficult situations.
Scientists have also discovered important differences between obese people and those 15 of average weight. In one experiment, participants were blindfolded and asked to taste different foods. The results showed that obese people generally have a stronger sense of taste and a greater desire for rich and flavorful foods. When they are not given enough variety or intensity of flavors, they often continue eating in an attempt to satisfy their cravings. Another study found that when overweight people looked at pictures of food, the 20 level of insulin in their blood increased. Insulin is a chemical that is closely linked to appetite and hunger. Interestingly, this reaction was not observed in people of average weight.

Health experts recommend exercise as an essential part of any weight-loss program. However, they emphasize that moderate physical activity is often more effective than extremely demanding exercise routines. Simple activities such as climbing stairs, walking regularly, or 25 cycling short distances can be maintained for long periods. In contrast, strenuous activities like long-distance jogging may be difficult to continue and can even increase appetite. Therefore, a balanced diet, regular exercise, and understanding the causes of overeating are key steps toward achieving and maintaining a healthy weight.

3 Read the text, then answer the questions:
When Places Remember
A historical landscape is more than a collection of old buildings, monuments, and ruins. It is a place where events from the past have left visible or invisible traces. A battlefield, an ancient street, a former factory, or even an ordinary house can become a site of memory when people connect it with important events, experiences, or individuals. Such places help (5) communities remember their past and consider how it continues to influence the present. However, sites of memory do not tell their stories automatically. The meaning of a place often depends on how it is preserved and presented. A ruined building, for example, may appear meaningless to a visitor who knows nothing about its history. Signs, photographs, recorded memories, and personal objects can provide context and transform a visit to an (10) unfamiliar place into a powerful historical experience. In this way, interpretation becomes as important as preservation.
This means that museums act as storytellers, but storytelling also involves responsibility. Museums must decide whose experiences to include and which voices may have been ignored in the past. Traditional exhibitions often focused on powerful leaders and major (15) political events. Today, many museums also include the experiences of workers, women, children, minority communities, and ordinary families. By presenting different perspectives, museums can offer a more complex understanding of history.
Technology has also changed how historical stories are communicated. Interactive screens, digital reconstructions, audio recordings, and virtual reality can help visitors imagine places (20) that no longer exist or events that no longer occur. Nevertheless, technology should support the historical story rather than distract from it. Impressive digital effects are of little value if visitors leave without understanding why a place or object matters.
Ultimately, historical landscapes and museums connect memory with the present. They remind us that history is not simply a list of dates and events. It consists of human (25) experiences that can be remembered, interpreted, and sometimes debated. By preserving significant places and telling their stories carefully, societies can help future generations understand both where they came from and how the past continues to shape their world.

(8) الوحدة 5 | CONCEPT 5: Sharing the Planet | UNIT 5: The Greenhouse Effect

◆ Unit Overview:
This unit explores the concept of responsibility in relation to one of the most urgent issues of our time: the climate crisis. You will examine the causes and consequences of climate change, investigate renewable energy solutions, explore how young people are taking environmental action, and study real green initiatives taking place in Egypt.
Through reading, discussion, inquiry, and writing tasks, you will develop the ability to analyze arguments critically, evaluate sources, construct JRE paragraphs, and communicate your ideas about environmental responsibility with clarity and confidence.

◆ Learning Objectives:
You will be able to:
Reading : Analyze informational text and articles to identify the causes, effects and evidence of climate change, evaluate arguments, and understand specific environmental initiatives and youth activism.
Listening : Comprehend expert podcasts and extract key information, including main ideas, specific details, and the speaker's perspective on renewable energy and the energy transition.
Speaking : Articulate and defend your opinion in discussions and debates on environmental issues, using claims supported by reasons and evidence and employing reported speech to present the viewpoints of others.
Writing : Construct well-structured argumentative paragraphs and information leaflets, using cause-and-effect structures, modal verbs, and adverbials of degree and frequency to present persuasive arguments and factual information clearly.

◆ Content Objectives
الأهداف الخاصة بالمحتوى
You will:
- Identify the main idea and supporting details in extended environmental texts.
- Analyze cause-and-effect relationships and evaluate arguments.
- Evaluate renewable energy solutions and sustainability strategies.
- Construct structured (JRE) arguments about environmental issues.

◆ Language Objectives
الأهداف الخاصة بمهارات اللغة الإنجليزية
You will:
- Use cause-and-effect structures (leads to, as a result, because of).
- Write structured argumentative paragraphs with clear claims and evidence.
- Write informational leaflets with headlines and calls to action.
- Use adverbials of degree and frequency to add precision and emphasis.

◆ Topic overview | نظرة عامة على الموضوع
Can our planet withstand the rapid pace of climate change?
Our planet’s climate is changing faster than at any point in recorded history. In this lesson, you will explore the science behind the climate crisis, examine its wide-ranging effects on people and ecosystems, and consider what urgent action looks like.
Inquiry Question: سؤال بحثي
What are the main causes and effects of climate change?
ما الأسباب الرئيسية لتغير المناخ وما نتائجه؟
Suggested answer:
The main causes include burning fossil fuels, deforestation, and industrial processes and factory emissions that release greenhouse gases into the atmosphere. These gases trap heat, leading to rising temperatures, melting ice, extreme weather, and threats to life on Earth.

◆ Reading Text | اقرا القطعة ثم اجب عن الأسئلة للتدريب على اسلبة قطعة الفهم.
The Climate Crisis: Understanding Our Burning Planet
by Dr. Amara Osei
The Earth’s climate is changing at a never-before-seen rate(1). Scientists around the world agree that human activity is the primary driver(2) of what we now call the climate crisis(3). Since the industrial revolution, the burning of fossil fuels—coal, oil, and natural gas—has released(4) billions of tonnes of carbon dioxide (CO₂) into the atmosphere. As a consequence(5), these emissions create what is known as the “Greenhouse Effect”, which traps heat and raises global temperatures.

THE GREENHOUSE EFFECT
Atmospheric gases CO₂, CH₄, N₂O
CO₂ ↑
Heat returned
Earth's surface

(1) معدل | (2) المحرك الرئيسي
(3) أزمة المناخ | (4) انطلق
(5) نتيجة

Melting ice & rising seas
The effects are already being felt across the planet. In the Arctic, ice sheets are melting at an alarming rate(6). Glaciers that have existed for thousands of years are getting smaller. As a result of this rapid melting, sea levels are rising, threatening coastal communities and low-lying island nations. Scientists predict that without immediate action, sea levels could rise by up to one meter by 2100, making hundreds of millions of people homeless.

Extreme weather events
Extreme weather events are becoming more frequent and more severe. Because of rising global temperature, hurricanes(7), wildfires, droughts, and floods are occurring with greater intensity(8). In 2023 alone, wildfires damaged parts of Canada, Greece, and Australia. Record-breaking temperatures were recorded on every continent. Consequently, the human and economic cost of these disasters is shocking and continues to grow each year.

Biodiversity loss
Biodiversity(9) is also under serious threat. Since habitats shift and temperatures change, countless species struggle to adapt. Coral reefs, often called the rain forests of the sea, are dying due to ocean warming and acidification(10). As a result, the Great Barrier Reef has experienced mass bleaching events repeatedly in recent years. Experts warn that human activity has led to the sixth mass extinction event in Earth’s history.

Food security threats
Agriculture and food security are at risk too. Due to changing rainfall patterns and extreme heat, crop production is being reduced in many parts of the world. As a result, regions that were once fertile(11) are becoming increasingly dry. Meanwhile, other areas face disastrous floods that destroy harvests. Sadly, the poorest communities, who contribute the least to climate change, are often the hardest hit.

(6) معدل مقلق | (7) الأعاصير | (8) الشدة
(9) التنوع البيولوجى | (10) التحُمض | (11) خصبة

The urgency of action
The scientific consensus(12) is clear. If global temperatures rise by more than 1.5°C above pre-industrial levels, the results could be disastrous and irreversible. The window for action is narrowing. Every fraction(13) of a degree matters. The decisions we make today, individually and collectively, will determine the kind of planet we leave for future generations.

(12) إجماع
(13) جزء

B Grammar Focus
Cause and effect
روابط السبب والنتيجة
نستخدم روابط السبب والنتيجة في الكتابة، وهي أيضًا جزء هام من القواعد لربط جملتين بينهما سبب أو نتيجة:
1 Cause أدوات ربط السبب
Because | As + subject + verb | Since | ,for
because of | on account of | as a result of | owing to | due to | thanks to | through + noun | adj. + noun
روابط يبعدها جملة كاملة:
Because (As/Since) he is clever, he always comes first.
- تأتي روابط السبب أولا الجملة أو وسطها وإذا جاءت أول الكلام لابد من وضع comma بين الجملتين للربط بينهما.
Ahmed was ill because he had eaten bad food.
- تركز because على سبب واضح بعدها يهتم به الطرف الثاني كثيرا لمعرفة لماذا حدث الشيء وهي تجيب دائمًا عن سؤال يبدأ بـ why .
Why did he feel ill? ... Because he had worked hard without rest.
- تركز since/as (لأن / بما أن) على سبب معروف أو واضح للمستمع، ويكون التركيز على النتيجة أكثر من السبب.
Since you are awake, make a cup of tea for me.
بما أنك مستيقظ، اصنع لي كوبًا من الشاي. (عمل الشاي ليس سببه الاستيقاظ)
Since it is raining, we will take a taxi.
بما أنها تمطر، سناخذ تاكسي.
- التركيز هنا على سبب اتخاذ القرار وليس سبب حدوث الشيء.
- لا تستخدم for أول الجملة ولكلما دائمًا في المنتصف وقبلها comma .
جملة السبب + ,for + جملة النتيجة
I believed her, for she had never lied to me before.
صدقتها لأنها لم تكذب أبدًا من قبل.
2 روابط بعدها جملة اسمية (noun/v-ing)
- استخدام because of وبعدها الاسم لبيان سبب حدوث الشيء.
Because of his illness, he wasn't chosen to play in the final.
- استخدام on account of في التقارير الإخبارية والسياقات الأكاديمية.
The flight was delayed on account of technical problems.
- نستخدم as a result of لبيان أن ما قبلها نتيجة حتمية لما بعدها.
Roads were blocked as a result of the landslide.
- نستخدم owing to & due to لربط النتيجة بالسبب، ولكن هناك فرقًا دقيقًا يفضل التزامه في الكتابة الأكاديمية:
- يعامل owing to كظرف، وبالتالي تبدأ بها الجملة أو تأتي بعد فعل أساسي.
Owing to his illness, he couldn't attend. (بسبب مرضه، لم يستطع الحضور)
- يعامل due to كصفة، والأصح نحوياً أن تأتي بعد فعل يكون (verb to be) لتصف الاسم.
His absence was due to illness. (غيابه كان بسبب المرض)
- يُستخدم Thanks to بمعنى (بفضل) عندما يكون السبب إيجابياً وأدى إلى نتيجة جيدة.
Thanks to your design, the booklet looks great.
- يُستخدم through بمعنى (من خلال / يفعل / بسبب)
He achieved top marks through hard work and dedication.

ملحوظة هامة:
- يمكن حذف because أول الجملة إذا كان فاعل الجملتين واحدًا، ووضع v-ing إذا كانت الجملة للمعلوم، أو وضع التصريف الثالث P.P. إذا كانت الجملة للمجهول.
Because Ali was ill, he couldn't come to school.
Being ill, Ali couldn't come to school..
Because Ali was punished severely, he didn't come back again.
Punished severely, Ali didn't come back again.
اللـظ: (because of the fact that/due to the fact that + جملة)
Because of the fact that he made mistakes, he was punished.

a) Because of b) Due to c) For d) Since
2. I didn't call you .................... I lost my phone and didn't remember your number.
a) while b) because c) because of d) thanks to
3. The match was called off .................... the sudden change in the weather.
a) because b) as c) on account of d) the fact that
4. His failure in the final exam was .................... his total lack of preparation.
a) due to b) because c) through d) owing to
5. .................... very tired after a long day at work, Ahmed went straight to bed.
a) Be b) Been c) Was d) Being
2 Rewrite the following sentences using the word(s) in brackets to give the same meaning:
1. The teacher punished the student because he had made many mistakes. (because of)
2. The weather was extremely cold. We decided to stay indoors. (Since)
3. He lost his job because of his carelessness. (careless)
3 Complete the following text with the appropriate structure:

(result) what happened. (3).................... (To) the delay, the students missed the morning assembly. (4).................... (Thank) cooperation, the school day ended successfully.
2 Result أدوات ربط النتيجة
subject + verb | therefore | so | consequently | subject + verb | that's why | as a result
فاعل + فعل | فاعل + فعل
Forests are being destroyed. As a result, a lot of animals are losing their homes.

1. so: (لذلك) - تأتي في منتصف الجملة وقبلها فاصلة (,).
Our team played badly, so they lost the match.
2. therefore/consequently/as a result: (بناءً على ذلك / نتيجة لذلك)
لها طريقتان في الكتابة:
- تأتي في جملة جديدة: تبدأ بحرف كبير وينتهي ما قبلها بنقطة (.)، ويأتي بعدها فاصلة ,
Forests are being destroyed. As a result, a lot of animals are losing their homes.
- أو تأتي في منتصف الجملة؛ يفصل بين الجملتين بفاصلة منقوطة (؛) ويأتي بعدها فاصلة (,).
Our team played badly; therefore, they lost the match.
3. that's why: (ولهذا السبب)
- تأتي لربط بين جملتين وتوضح النتيجة مباشرةً.
He didn't study; that's why he failed the exam.
اللـظ
يمكن استخدام أفعال للتعبير عن النتيجة أو التأثير مثل lead to/ result in/ cause
Releasing greenhouse gases leads to/ results in/ causes extreme temperatures problems.

◆ Topic overview | نظرة عامة على الموضوع
Can Nature Power the World?
From solar farms in the Egyptian desert to offshore wind turbines in the North Sea, renewable energy is transforming how the world powers itself. In this lesson, you will listen to an expert podcast, evaluate the evidence for the energy transition, and practice producing an informational leaflet.
Inquiry question: | سؤال بحثي
What other renewable energy solutions exist today?
ما هي حلول الطاقة المتجددة الأخرى الموجودة اليوم؟
Suggested answer:
There are several solutions, like hydropower energy, geothermal energy, biomass energy, and hydrogen fuel cells.
Renewable Energy Sources
Solar | Wind | Hydro | Geothermal
Photovoltaic panels convert sunlight into electricity | Turbines harness kinetic wind energy | Moving water drives turbines | Earth's heat powers turbines
90% cost drop | Fastest growing | Reliable baseload | 24/7 power
Benban Solar Park — Egypt's flagship clean energy project | Offshore farms provide consistent clean power | Provides stable power regardless of weather | Consistent energy with very low carbon footprint

◆ Listening Text
Scan & listen
Marcus Green: Welcome back to Green Futures. I'm joined today by Doctor Layla Hussein, energy economist and clean energy support. Today we're focusing mainly on the success stories and the potential of the energy transition. Really celebrating what's working. Doctor Hussein, let's start with the basics. Which renewable(1) energy source is leading the charge right now?
Layla Hussein: Solar without question, solar energy is currently the fastest growing renewable source worldwide, and the cost of solar panels has fallen by nearly ninety percent in the last decade. That means that in many countries, renewable energy is now actually cheaper than fossil fuels(2). Wind and solar together now provide a significant share of global electricity. And that share is growing every year.
Marcus Green: So what are the real-world success stories you find most encouraging?
Layla Hussein: There are many. Take Denmark, a country that has successfully transitioned to generating over sixty percent of its electricity from wind. And importantly, this transition has created thousands of new jobs in engineering, manufacturing, and maintenance. The idea that moving to renewables means losing employment is simply not true. In fact, the opposite is happening. Developing nations are also increasingly leapfrogging fossil fuels entirely and moving straight to renewables, which is extraordinary. Green hydrogen is also emerging as a promising solution for heavy industry, where direct electrification is difficult.
Marcus Green: What about the challenges? Is battery(3) technology still holding things back?
Layla Hussein: Battery technology was a major obstacle, but not anymore. Advances in battery storage are rapidly solving the problem of intermittency(4). The fact that the sun and wind are not constant. Storage is the real game changer here. I should also add that this transition requires both public and private investment(5) working together. Public investment alone is simply not enough. We need businesses, governments, and international institutions all committed. And on that note, I must be honest not all governments have committed to a fully renewable future, yet. That remains one of our biggest political challenges.
Marcus Green: So where does that leave us overall?
Layla Hussein: I am genuinely optimistic. The move away from fossil fuels is no longer just an environmental choice. It is an economic(6) one with the right investment and support from governments and businesses. A fully renewable energy grid is absolutely achievable(7) within our lifetime. In our next segment, we will explore the policy frameworks that are making this possible.
(1) متجدد | (2) وقود أحفوري
(3) بطارية | (4) تقطع
(5) استثمار | (6) اقتصادي
(7) قابل للتحقيق

Definitions | التعريفات
investment | استثمار | the use of money to get a profit or to make a business activity successful, or the money that is used

renewable | متجدد | easily replaced because there is a large supply of it
battery | بطارية | an object that provides a supply of electricity for something such as a radio, car, or toy
fossil fuel | وقود أحفوري | a fuel such as coal or oil that is produced by the very gradual decaying تحلل of animals or plants over millions of years
intermittency | تقطع | coming and going at intervals فواصل زمنية : not continuous
achievable | قابل للتحقيق | capable of being achieved

B Grammar Focus

Modal verbs

تستخدم الأفعال الناقصة (Modal verbs) وهي الأفعال المشروطة بالصدر بعدها الضرورة والاستطاعة والاحتمال وإعطاء الآذن والطلب والاقتراح والنصيحة ... الخ.

1 Necessity الضرورة

must - have to/has to

كلاهما يقيد الضرورة والاضطرار لفعل شئ ولكن الاختلاف فيمن يقيد الضرورة.
- تعقيب must الضرورة الشخصية (ظروف شخصية تضطروك لذلك) والشخص يكون موافقا لهذه الضرورة واضعا عنها.
Meaning المعنى
I must visit Ramy on Saturday as I promised to visit him.
- وتقيد have to ضرورة مفروضة من الخارج ليس لديك اختيار في فعلها.
I have to get up early on school days.
Question السؤال
Must he make noise at this time of the night?
Do they have to wear ties at work?
Negative النفي
You mustn't make noise; dad is asleep.
You don't have to get up early tomorrow; it's a vacation.
Passive المجهول
A report must be written by Ali.
The car has to be repaired before the feast.

2 Giving and asking for advice

(should/ought to – shouldn't/oughtn't to)

هناك تعبيرات مختلفة لتقديم النصيحة أو النصيحة، لاحظ التالي:
had better | I advise you to ...
It is advisable ... to ...
should | = | If I were you, I would ...
It is important to ...
ought to | It would be a good idea

We use them for suggestions and advice.
- تستخدم should, ought to, had better للنصيحة.
You should always wash your hands after you have touched the cat.
You should drink more water. (general advice; I advise you)
You ought to respect the elderly. (I advise you; most people believe this)
You'd better see your dentist. (advice for a specific situation)
وتستخدم should لإعطاء النصيحة أو طلبها، وكذلك عند التعبير عن الرأي باستخدام:
(I think – I don't think – Do you think?)
I don't think you should apply for this job. The average salary is very low.
I think my children should do their best to pass their exams.

shouldn't | I advise you not to ...
oughtn't to = It is inadvisable ... to ...
If I were you, I wouldn't ...
It isn't important to ...
had better not It wouldn't be a good idea to ...
You shouldn't/oughtn't to/had better not waste your time doing useless things.
3 ability/potential | المقدرة/الاستطاعة
present | past | future
can | could | will be able to
(am/is/are) able to | was/were able to
It is possible for surgeons to transplant hearts.
Surgeons can (are able to) transplant hearts.
It was possible for me to read and write before the age of 5.
I could read and write before the age of 5.
could have + P.P. كان في الإمكان فعل شيء ولم يفعله
I went to school on foot, but I could have gone by bus.
can/be able to/capable/ability/enable
My friend | can/could + inf. | speak English.
My friend | is/was able to + inf. | speak English.
My friend | is/was capable of + v-ing | speaking English.
My friend | has/had the ability to + inf. | speak English.
Money enables يُمكِن us to buy what we need.
لاحظ استخدام possible للأحتمال إذا جاء بعدها that وفي هذه الحالة نستبدلها ب may .
It's possible for + object للاستطاعة ... .
It's possible for him to read English novels without a dictionary.
It's possible that + subject + verb للاحتمال .... .
It is possible that it will rain tomorrow. = It may rain tomorrow.
تُفيد could الاستطاعة العامة في الماضي أما be able to فتفيد الاستطاعة في مواقف معينة أو بعد مجهول..
My brother could drive our family car when he was in preparatory school. (General ability)
My rival was strong, but I was able to beat him.
The questions were difficult, but the students were able to answer them.

4 possibility | الاحتمال
may/might
Present/future | Past
may/might + inf. | may/might have + P.P.
It's possible that Ali will visit us tomorrow. | Ali may (might) visit us tomorrow.
Perhaps they won the match. | They may (might) have won the match.
تستخدم might للاحتمال في المضارع ولكنهما أقل احتمالاً من may .
My uncle may visit us tomorrow. (It is possible, but we aren't sure.)
My uncle might visit us tomorrow. (There's a small chance)
can/could
can | نستخدم can عندما نتحدث عن شيء ممكن حدوثه عموماً، أو حقيقة عامة يعرفها الناس، وليس موقفاً معيناً في المستقبل. Smoking can cause cancer. | التدخين يمكن أن يسبب السرطان. (احتمال طبي/علمي عام ومُثبت)
could | نستخدم could للتعبير عن احتمالية ضعيفة أو غير مؤكدة في المستقبل أو الحاضر (قريبة من معنى may أو might) Solar energy could power entire cities by 2050.
ملحوظة هامة | كل modal verbs في المجهول يأتي بعدها be + P.P. وإذا كان بعده have أي في الماضي نستخدم have been + P.P. مثل:
Solar energy (may/could) be used in our homes by 2030.
Ali's car may/might/could have been repaired yesterday, but I'm not sure.

Grammar
1 Choose the correct answer from a, b, c, or d:

◆ Topic overview | نظرة عامة على الموضوع
What is Egypt's plan to turn green?
Egypt is taking significant steps toward a greener future. In this lesson, you will read about real environmental initiatives across the country, evaluate their effectiveness, and consider what more can be done – by governments and by individuals.
Inquiry Question: | سؤال يحثى
How are green projects helping Egypt respond to environmental challenges?
كيف تساعد المشاريع الخضراء مصر فى مواجهة التحديات البيئية؟
Suggested answer:
Green projects in Egypt are helping to reduce pollution, conserve water, generate clean energy, and protect natural resources—making the country more sustainable and resilient to climate change.

◆ Listening Text
Scan & listen
In recent years, Egypt has taken important steps to protect the environment and move toward a greener future. One of the most well-known projects is the Benban Solar Park, which is one of the largest solar energy projects in the world. It produces clean electricity using sunlight and helps reduce pollution caused by fossil fuels.
Another major initiative(1) is the "Go Green Initiative", launched by the Ministry of Environment. This project aims to raise awareness(2) among citizens about protecting natural resources, reducing plastic use, and recycling(3) waste. It encourages people, especially young learners, to take responsibility for their environment.
(1) مبادرة | (2) وعى
(3) إعادة التدوير | (4) كفاءة
(5) انبعاثات | (6) استدامة
Egypt is also working on improving cities through the Green Cities Program, which includes projects in Cairo such as waste recycling, clean transportation, and energy efficiency(4) in buildings. These projects aim to make cities healthier and more sustainable places to live.
In addition, the government and international organizations are supporting recycling projects, especially in electronic waste. New laws and programs help manage e-waste safely and encourage small businesses to recycle materials instead of throwing them away.
Another example is the development of Sharm El-Sheikh as a "green city", where hotels use solar energy, and public transport is becoming more environmentally friendly. These efforts aim to reduce carbon emissions(5) and protect natural resources.
These projects show that Egypt is moving towards sustainability(6). However, success depends not only on governments but also on individuals who must change their daily habits and support green solutions.

Definitions | التعريفات
awareness | وعي | the state of knowing about and understanding a particular issue
efficiency | كفاءة | the ability to perform a task with minimum waste of time and resources
emissions | انبعاثات | gases released into the atmosphere, especially those causing pollution
initiative | مبادرة | a plan or program introduced to achieve a specific goal
recycling | إعادة التدوير | the process of converting waste materials into new, reusable products
sustainability | استدامة | the ability to meet present needs without harming future generations

◆ FOCUS on Vocabulary
لاحظ الفرق بين الكلمات التالية:
(1) plan
١- خطة/مخطط (فكرة أو ترتيب مسبق لتحقيق هدف).
٢- خريطة/تصميم (رسم توضيحي).
- We need a clear plan to reduce pollution in the city.
- The government has a new plan to build more schools.
- She drew a plan of the new garden.
conspiracy = plot
مؤامرة/تآمر (خطة سرية تضعها مجموعة من الأشخاص للقيام بأعمال غير قانونية أو ضارة).
The journalist uncovered a conspiracy to hide the truth.
initiative
مبادرة (خطة جديدة لمعالجة مشكلة معينة أو لتحقيق هدف معين).
- The new recycling initiative has helped reduce waste.
- The government launched an initiative to plant more trees.
(2) process
١- عملية/سلسلة من الخطوات (طريقة يتم بها إنجاز شيء).
٢- سير/تقدم (تغير تدريجي يحدث مع مرور الوقت).
- The recycling process involves sorting, cleaning, and melting materials.
- Learning a new language is a slow process that takes time.
operation
١- عملية تشغيل/نشاط (طريقة عمل شيء أو نظام).
٢- عملية جراحية (إجراء طبي).
٣- عملية حسابية (جمع، طرح).
٤- عملية عسكرية/مهمة منظمة.
- The operation of the new solar panels is very efficient.
- The patient needs a serious operation on his heart.
- Simple math operations like addition and subtraction are easy.
- The army carried out a rescue operation after the earthquake.
(3) evaluate
١- يُقيّم/يُقدّر (الحكم على قيمة أو جودة أو أهمية شيء ما).
٢- يُقيّم (دراسة شيء بعناية لمعرفة مدى نجاحه).
- Teachers evaluate students' performance through tests and assignments.
- We need to evaluate the results before making a decision.
estimate
١- يُقدّر/يحسب تقريبيًا (تخمين رقمي بناءً على معلومات متوفرة).
٢- تقدير/تخمين (المبلغ أو العدد التقريبي).
- Can you estimate how much water we use each day?
- The builder gave us an estimate of 5,000 pounds for the repairs.

B Grammar Focus
Adverbials of degree and frequency
أنصِم الجمل الظرفية (Adverbials) هي كلمات أو عبارات تستخدمها للإجابة عن أسئلة (مثل: كيف، كم، متى، أو كم مرة يحدث الشيء).
1 | Adverbials of Degree | ظروف الدرجة
وظيفتها: تُبيّن مدى أو كمية حدوث الشيء.
Show how much/to what extent
barely | بالكاد /بصعوبة | marginally | بشكل هامشي/ضئيل جدًا
completely | تمامًا/بالكامل | moderately | بشكل معتدل /متوسط
considerably | بشكل ملحوظ | partially | جزئيًّا
enormously | بشكل هائل /ضخم | partly | جزئيًّا /إلى جزء ما
entirely | كليًّا /بأكمله | scarcely | بالكاد /نادرًا جدًّا
fully | بالكامل /كليًّا | significantly | بشكل ملحوظ /كبير
greatly | بدرجة كبيرة | slightly | بشكل طفيف /قليل
heavily | بثقل /بشدة /بقوة | substantially | بدرجة جوهرية /ملموسة
immensely | للغاية /بدرجة هائلة | totally | تمامًا/ مطلقًا
largely | إلى حد كبير
Egypt has significantly reduced its reliance on fossil fuels.
لقد خفّضت مصر اعتمادها على الوقود الأحفوري بدرجة كبيرة جدًا.
(هنا الظرف يوضّح «حجم أو مدى» الانخفاض)
The project is fully green.
The village is completely powered by solar energy.
The electricity comes entirely from clean sources.
Clean energy investments have grown enormously.
The place of the adverb | مكان ظرف الدرجة في الجملة
1 | Subj. + verb + adverb of degree + adj. or adv.
— يأتي ظرف الدرجة قبل الصفة أو الحال.
The wind turbines turn immensely fast.
2 | Subj.+ adverb of degree + main verb.
— إذا كان ظرف الدرجة يصف فعلًا أساسيًّا، فإنه يوضع قبل الفعل مباشرة.
The government partially funds solar energy.

3 | Subj. + auxiliary/helping verb فعل مساعد + adverb of degree + main verb.
— إذا كانت الجملة تحتوي على فعل مساعد (مثل: is, are, was, were, have, has, will, can) وفعل أساسي، يوضع ظرف الدرجة بين الفعل المساعد والفعل الأساسي (في المنتصف).
The factory is completely powered by solar energy.
Carbon emissions will substantially drop next year.
4 | At the end of the sentence
— في نهاية الجملة لتصف قوة أو حجم الفعل مثل:
completely, totally, enormously, immensely, partially.
They closed down the old coal factory completely.
تنبيه هام: في الاستعممال المعتاد، لا يوضع ظرف الدرجة بين الفعل والمفعول به المباشر.
We reduced completely our reliance on oil. (X)
We completely reduced our reliance on oil. (✓)
We reduced our reliance on oil completely. (✓)

a) partly | b) slightly | c) completely | d) moderately
4. The government ................ funds the new school project, while local charities pay the rest.
a) partially | b) totally | c) fully | d) entirely
5. Choose the sentence that has the INCORRECT word order: ................
a) The job is totally new. | b) She loves her new job totally.
c) She totally loves her new job. | d) She loves totally her new job.
2 | Rewrite the following sentences using the word(s) in brackets to give the same meaning:
1. Egypt reduced its dependence on oil in a very big and noticeable way. (significantly)
2. I could not hear the whisper because it was very quiet. (scarcely)
3. All the houses in the new city are powered by solar energy. (fully)
4. The prices of electric cars will drop in a very large way next year. (substantially)
5. The teacher agrees with your excellent idea one hundred percent. (entirely)
3 | Complete the following text with the appropriate structure:
Sara is interested in learning languages. She (1) ................ (frequent) watches English videos after school. She finds them (2) ................ (extreme) useful for improving her pronunciation. She has (3) ................ (become gradual) more confident while speaking English. She (4) ................ (probable will) study abroad one day.

2 | Adverbials of Frequency | ظروف التكرار
وظيفتها: تُبيّن «كم مرة» أو «مدى تكرار أو انتظام» حدوث الشيء.
Show how often something happens.
always | دائمًا | occasionally | من حين لآخر/للمانسبات
annually = yearly | سنويًّا | often | غالبًا
consistently | بثبات /باستمرار | once a week | مرة في الأسبوع
daily | يوميًّا | rarely | نادرًا
frequently | بشكل متكرر/كثيرًا | regularly | بانتظام
generally | عمومًا/بشكل عام | seldom | نادرًا
hardly ever | نادرًا/قلما | sometimes | أحيانًا
increasingly | بشكل متزايد | twice a month | مرتين في الشهر
monthly | شهريًّا | usually | عادةً
never | أبدًا | weekly | أسبوعيًّا
normally | طبيعيًّا/في العادة
Egypt is increasingly investing in clean energy solutions.
تستثمر مصر بشكل متزايد في حلول الطاقة النظيفة.
هنا الظرف يوضّح أن الاستمرار ليس ثابتًا بل يتكبر ويزداد وتيرةً بمرور الوقت.
The place of the adverb | مكان ظرف التكرار في الجملة
Subj. + adverb of frequency + main verb
1 | يوضع قبل الفعل الأساسي مباشرة.
I always study at night.
He never eats fast food.
2 | إذا كان الفعل الأساسي في الجملة هو أحد أشكال (am, is, are, was, were)، فإن ظرف التكرار يأتي بعده مباشرة.
She is usually late.
They are often busy.
3 | إذا كانت الجملة تحتوي على فعل مساعد مثل: (can, will, have, must)، يوضع ظرف التكرار بين الفعل المساعد والفعل الأساسي.
You must always wash your hands.
4 | يأتي ظرف التكرار بعد أداة النفي (not) وقبل الفعل الأساسي.
I do not often watch TV.
5 | الكلمات التي تحدد الوقت بدقة مثل (Daily, Weekly, Every day, Once a week) تأتي دائمًا في آخر الجملة (وإحيانًا في أولها لغرض التأكيد)، ولا تنطبق عليها القواعد السابقة.
I go to the gym twice a week.

3 | Adverbials of Certainty/Stance | ظروف التأكيد /الرأي
وظيفتها: تُعبّر عن «رأي الكاتب، أو مدى ثقته ويقينه» من الكلام، أو موقفه الشخصي تجاه المعلومة وعادة ما تأتي في أول الجملة متبوعة بفاصلة.
absolutely | تمامًا/ مطلقًا | fortunately | لحسن الحظ | plainly | بصراحة/ يوضح
arguably | من الممكن القول | frankly/honestly | بصراحة | possibly | ربما /من الممكن
certainly | بالتأكيد | generally | عمومًا | probably | من المحتمل /المرجح
clearly | يوضوح | inevitably | حتما/ لا مفر منه | surprisingly | للعجب /بشكل مفاجئ
currently | حاليًّا | likely | من المحتمل | undoubtedly | بلا شك
definitely | قطعاً/بالتأكيد | obviously | بديهيًّا/ من الواضح | unfortunately | لسوء الحظ
evidently | بجلال /يوضوح | perhaps/Maybe | ربما
Clearly, individual action alone is not enough to solve the crisis.
يوضح، العمل الفردي وحده لا يكفي لحل الأزمة.
هنا الكاتب يعبر عن «موقفه ورأيه اليقيني» تجاه هذه القضية.
