◆ Topic overview | نظرة عامة على الموضوع
How can we make change?
From viral speeches to ocean cleanup projects, young people around the world are refusing to wait for adults to solve the climate crisis. In this lesson, you will read about youth action, analyze arguments and evidence, and plan your own Eco-Leaders program.
Inquiry Question: سؤال بحثي
How are young people leading the fight to save the planet?
كيف يقود الشباب المعركة لإنقاذ الكوكب؟
Suggested answer:
Young people are launching green startups, volunteering in environmental campaigns, and adopting sustainable daily habits. They also spread awareness through blogs, podcasts, and school projects to inspire collective action for the planet.
اقرأ القطعة ثم أجب عن الأسئلة للتدريب على أسئلة قطعة الفهم.

◆ Reading Text
Last spring, the Egyptian Youth Environment Network held its annual conference in Cairo. The conference coordinator, Ms. Hana Karim, opened the event by saying that she had never seen so much determination(1) from young Egyptians in all her years of environmental work. She added that the solutions to Egypt's environmental challenges were already being developed by students and young innovators(2) across the country.
One inspiring story came from Omar Taha, an engineering student from Cairo University. He told the audience that his team had designed a low-cost solar water heater that could be installed on ordinary rooftops. He explained that the device could reduce a family's electricity bill by up to forty percent. When a journalist asked him whether the technology was affordable(3) for lower-income families, Omar replied that the total cost of materials was less than three hundred Egyptian pounds.
مبتكرون (2) | إصرار/تصميم/عزيمة (1)
بأسعار معقولة (3) | بارز/لا يُنسى (4)
بسرعة (5) | بموقع خاص (6)
ابتكار (7) | مشاركون (8)
Another memorable(4) moment came from Farida Mustafa, a sixteen-year-old from Luxor. She said that she had started a Nile clean-up campaign with just five friends and that it had grown to over two hundred volunteers within a year. She warned that the river was changing rapidly(5) and that their generation had a responsibility to protect it. She encouraged everyone to take action, however small, in their local community.
As the conference closed, Ms. Karim reminded the delegates that Egypt was specially positioned(6) to lead environmental innovation(7) in Africa. She told the young participants(8) that the decisions their generation made in the coming years would shape the future of the country and the planet.

JRE (Justify – Reason – Evidence) مجاب عنه نهاية الكتاب.
1. To what extent should young people lead environmental change in their communities? SB
2. Do you agree that taking small actions is more effective than waiting for large-scale change? Give evidence to support your claim. SB
A) Answer the following questions:
1. Explain: What specific example of youth innovation does the text provide involving clean energy for Egyptian homes? SB
2. What message did Farida give to other young people? SB
3. Analyze: What challenge does Farida Mustafa warn about, and what evidence does she give that young people can make a difference? SB
4. Evaluate: Do you think Omar's project can make a real difference in Egypt? Justify your answer.
5. To what extent are young people responsible for environmental protection? SB
B) Choose the correct answer from a, b, c, or d:
6. Find a word in paragraph 1 which is similar in meaning to "a strong will to finish a task". SB
a) communication
b) innovation
c) determination
d) participation
7. Which detail shows that Omar's idea is affordable for many families? SB
a) It was presented at a conference.
b) It uses solar energy.
c) It can reduce electricity bills.
d) The materials cost less than 300 Egyptian pounds.
8. Which of the following does the article suggest young Egyptian activists are NOT doing? SB
a) Using innovation and technology.
b) Organizing community campaigns.
c) Ignoring environmental problems.
d) Working with community volunteers.
Definitions | التعريفات
affordable | بأسعار معقولة | cheap enough for most people to afford
determination | إصرار/تصميم/عزيم | the quality of trying to do something even when it is difficult
innovation | ابتكار | the introduction of new ideas or methods
innovators | مبتكرون | people who introduce changes and new ideas
memorable | بارز/لا يُنسى | very good, enjoyable, or unusual, and worth remembering
participants | مشاركون | people who are taking part in an activity or event
rapidly | بسرعة | very quickly and in a very short time

◆ FOCUS on Vocabulary
لاحظ الفرق بين الكلمات التالية:
1 summit اـ قمة جبل - It took us six hours to reach the summit.
مـ مؤتمر قمة - The G20 summit قمة العشرين will be held in India this year.
top اـ أعلى/قمة - Write your name at the top of the page.
مـ الأفضل/الأول/الأعلى مريبة - She is one of the top students in her class.

2 install اـ يركّب جهازًا أو بيده للتشغيل - Security cameras have been installed in the city center.
مـ يثبّت برنامجًا في جهاز كمبيوتر أو تليفون محمول. - We've installed new anti-virus software.
fix اـ يثبّت شيئًا في شيء، آخر ليبلغ مدة طويلة - The shelves should be fixed to the wall by a carpenter.
مـ يصلح - He's outside fixing the brakes of the car.
3 meeting اجتماع (أُنْشخاص غالبًا يتنمون لمكان واحد). - The staff are having a meeting next week to discuss the company's problems.
conference مؤتمر (أُنْشخاص غالبًا من أماكن مختلفة). - The Arab Summit Conference is held in March every year.
interview مقابلة شخصية لـ (وظيفة/صحافة/إذاعة). - Mary has an interview next week for a teaching job in Paris.
- A famous reporter is having an interview with the President tonight.
appointment موعد مع (شخص/طبيب). - I'd like to make an appointment to see the doctor.
4 material تستخدم كلمة (material) (كاسم معدود/اسم غير معدود/صفة) وبمعانٍ مختلفة منها:
اـ مادة خام - Wood and steel are basic building materials.
مـ قماش/نسيج - This dress is made of a soft cotton material.
٣ـ مادة علمية - The teacher gave us extra reading material for the exam.
٤ـ لوازم/أدوات - The office needs new stationery material.
٥ـ جوهري/مادي/مهم - This evidence is material to the case.

Grammar Focus
A. Cause and effect
روابط السبب والنتيجة
1 Cause
أدوات ربط السبب
1 روابط يعدھا جملة كاملة:
Because
As
Since
جملة (Subj. + v +....) ▶ بسبب / وتبًـا لان ▶ جملة (Subj. + v +....)
جملة (Subj. + V + ...) , for
As she was well-prepared, she answered all the questions confidently.
The children stayed indoors because it was raining heavily outside.
Why was the meeting postponed? Because the manager was traveling abroad.
Since you know the answer, explain it to your classmates.
جملة السبب + , for + جملة النتيجة
He won the scholarship, for he had achieved excellent grades throughout the year.
2 روابط يعدھا عبارة اسمية (noun/v-ing)
because of
due to
on account of
as a result of
owing to
thanks to
through
جملة (subj. + v + ...) ▶ noun/adj. + noun + بسبب / نتيجة ل
بفضل
من خلال
We missed the beginning of the film because of/due to the heavy traffic.
Owing to poor weather conditions, the match was canceled.
The roads were closed on account of flooding in the area.
She improved her English through reading and practicing every day.
Many flights were delayed as a result of dense fog at the airport.
Thanks to modern technology, communication has become easier than ever.
ملحوظة هامة يمكن حذف because أول الجملة وضع V.ing إذا كانت الجملة معلوم ووضع التصريف الثالث P.P. إذا كانت الجملة مجهول.
Because the students were feeling hungry, they left the library early.
➔ Feeling hungry, the students left the library early.
Because Ali was punished severely, he didn't come back again.
Punished severely, Ali didn't come back again.
لاحظ (جملة + because of the fact that/due to the fact that)
Because of the fact that he made mistakes, he was punished.

2 Result
أدوات ربط النتيجة
therefore
so
consequently
that's why
as a result
Subject فاعل + verb فعل ▶ Subject فاعل + verb فعل
- تأتي في منتصف الجملة وقيلها فاصلة.
1. so: (لذلك)
The printer ran out of paper, so we couldn't finish the reports on time.
2. جملة + Therefore/Consequently/As a result, (.) جملة.
جملة. + بناءً على ذلك/وتيجة لذلك.
He spent several months preparing for the competition. Consequently, he won first place.
The factory increased its production. As a result, more workers were employed.
(جملة + ; + therefore/consequently/as a result,)
The player suffered a minor injury; therefore, he didn't complete the match.
The river overflowed after the heavy rain; as a result, several roads were closed.
3. That's why (ولهذا السبب)
تأتي لربط بين جملتين وتوضح النتيجة مباشرة.
She didn't charge her phone; that's why she couldn't answer my calls.

B. Modal verbs
الأفعال الناقصة
تستخدم الأفعال الناقصة (Modal verbs) وهي الأفعال المشروطة بالمصدر بعدها للتعبير عن الضرورة والاستطاعة والاحتمال وإعطاء الإذن والطلب والاقتراح والنصيحة، ...إلخ

1. Necessity (الضرورة)
must
ضرورة شخصية.
قرار أو شعور (داخلي) الشخص راض عنها.
have to/has to
ضرورة مفروضة من الخارج.
قوانين – ظروف – مدرسة ... لا يوجد اختيار.

السؤال | النفي | الممنوع للجمهور
Must she take medicine every day? | You mustn't park here; it's a no-parking zone. | The homework must be submitted online.

ملحوظة: كلاهما – «يجب» لكن الاختلاف في مصدر فرض الضرورة.

2. Advice (النصيحة)
should/ ought to/ had better
للنصيحة والاقتراح
- I advise you to ...
- It is advisable to ...
- If I were you, I would ...
- It is important to ...
- It would be a good idea to ...

shouldn't/ oughtn't to/ had better not
النصيحة بعدم فعل شىء
- I advise you not to ...
- It is inadvisable to ...
- If I were you, I wouldn't ...
- It isn't important to ...
- It wouldn't be a good idea to ...

MODAL VERBS
الأفعال الناقصة

3. Ability (الاستطاعة)
Present | Past | Future
can | could | will be able to
am/is/are able to | was/were able to

could
استطاعة عامة في الماضي.

was/were able to
استطاعة في موقف معين أو بعد مجهود.

صور أخرى للتعبير عن القدرة:
- be capable of + v-ing
- have the ability to + inf.
- enable + object + inf.
قادر على
لديه القدرة على
يمكن

could have + P.P.
كان يستطيع ولكن لم يفعل.

Possible
اللاستطاعة | للاحتمال
It is possible for + obj + to + inf. = be able to | It is possible that + subj. + v. = may

4. Probability/Possibility (الاحتمال)
1. may/might
Present/Future | Past
may/might + Inf. | may/might have + P.P.

2. can/could
can | could
احتمال عام/ حقيقة علمية مؤكدة. | احتمال ضعيف أو غير مؤكد.

ملحوظة هامة
كل modal verbs في المجهول يأتى بعدها be + P.P. وإذا كانت الجملة تعبير عن الماضى نستخدم have been + P.P. بعد الفعل الناقص.

Passive (المبنى للمجهول)
Present/Future | Past
Modal verb + be + P.P. | Modal verb + have been + P.P.
The books must be returned by Friday. | The homework may have been done already.
The letter should be posted today. | The package could have been delivered.
The doors can be opened now. | The report should have been completed.

أهم التحويلات في: Rewrite

must → It's necessary ...
should → It's advisable ...
shouldn't → It's inadvisable ...
can → be able to/It's possible for
could → was/were able to في موقف معين
may → it is possible that
It is possible that → may
could have + P.P. → was possible to ... but didn't
be capable of + v-ing → can
have the ability to → can
enable → make ... able to

جدول الضرورة المهمة:

must | ضرورة داخلية | could | قدرة عامة في الماضي أو احتمال ضعيف
have to | ضرورة خارجية | be able to | قدرة فى موقف معين
mustn't | ممنوع | will be able to | قدرة مستقبلية
don't have to | ليس ضروريا | may | احتمال كبير نسبيا
should/ought to | نصيحة | might | احتمال أقل
had better | نصيحة قوية لموقف معين | could have + P.P. | كان يستطيع ولم يفعل
can | قدرة حالية/احتمال عام | may/might have + P.P. | ربما حدث في الماضى

القسم C | Section (C): المهارات — Study Skills
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

An argumentative paragraph | الفقرة الجدلية

An argumentative paragraph is a paragraph where you give your opinion and support it with reasons and examples.

الفقرة الجدلية هي فقرة تُقدّم فيها رأيك وتدعمه بالأسباب والأمثلة.

Structure of an argumentative paragraph

Topic Sentence | Supporting Sentences | Concession (Optional) | Concluding Sentence

State your opinion clearly. This is the MAIN IDEA of the paragraph.
عبر عن رأيك بوضوح. هذه هي الفكرة الرئيسية للفقرة.

Give 2-3 reasons or pieces of evidence to support your opinion.
قدّم سببين أو ثلاثة أسباب أو أدلة لدعم رأيك.

Mention the opposite view, then refute it. This makes your argument stronger.
اذكر الرأي المخالف، ثم ادحضه. هذا يجعل حجتك أقوى.

Restate your opinion in different words. Do NOT introduce a new idea.
أعد صياغة رأيك بكلمات مختلفة. لا تعرض فكرة جديدة.

MODEL Argumentative Paragraph

What does it mean to take responsibility for the environment in today's world?

Taking responsibility for the environment in today's world means recognizing that our daily actions have a direct impact on the planet and future generations. I strongly believe that every individual has a duty to protect the environment, not only governments and large organizations. Simple actions such as reducing waste, recycling materials, conserving water, and using public transportation can make a significant difference when practiced by millions of people. Moreover, environmental responsibility involves raising awareness among others about issues such as climate change, pollution, and biodiversity loss. Some people argue that individual efforts are too small to solve global environmental problems. However, history has shown that collective action often begins with personal commitment. When citizens adopt sustainable habits and support environmentally friendly initiatives, they encourage businesses and policymakers to take stronger action as well. In addition, schools can play an important role by teaching students the value of sustainability and environmental stewardship. In conclusion, taking responsibility for the environment means making conscious choices that protect natural resources and contribute to a healthier, cleaner, and more sustainable future for everyone.

Informational Leaflet | نشرة إعلامية

An informational leaflet is a compact, single-page or folded printed document designed to educate readers about a specific subject.

النشرة الإعلامية هي وثيقة مطبوعة صغيرة الحجم، إما من صفحة واحدة أو مطوية، مصممة لتثقيف القراء حول موضوع محدد.

Key Features of a Well-Written Informational Leaflet

Eye-catching headline | Grab the reader's attention immediately — use a question or bold statement.
عنوان لافت للنظر | اجذب انتباه القارئ فورًا — استخدم سؤالًا أو عبارة جريئة.

Subheadings | Organize content into clear, easy-to-navigate sections.
عناوين فرعية | قم بتنظيم المحتوى في أقسام واضحة وسهلة التصفح.

Bullet points | Present key information concisely and accessibly.
نقاط مختصرة | قدم المعلومات الأساسية بإيجاز وبطريقة سهلة الفهم.

Call to action | Encourage the reader to do something specific: "Switch to solar today!"
دعوة للعمل | شجع القارئ على القيام بشيء محدد: «حوّل إلى الطاقة الشمسية اليوم!».

Tone and register | Match the intended audience — friendly yet informative for young people.
النغمة والتسجيل | يجب أن يناسب الجمهور المستهدف وأن يكون لطيفًا وفي الوقت نفسه يكون غنيًا بالمعلومات للشباب.

Visuals | Images or diagrams support and enhance the written text.
مرئيات | تدعم الصور أو الرسوم البيانية النص المكتوب وتعززه.

Model Informational Leaflet

Green Energy Guide
Why are you still paying for Energy the sun gives for free?
Everything you need to know about switching to solar and why young people are leading the charge.

What is Solar Energy?
Solar panels capture sunlight and convert it into electricity for your home.
Excess energy can be stored or sold back to the grid.

Why Should Young People Care?
Climate change is your generation's biggest challenge—solar is an easy solution.
Young people are already running solar-powered startups!

How Do You Get Started?
Talk to your parents or your school about installing rooftop solar panels.
Start small: solar-powered chargers are a great first step.

The Nile is one of Egypt's most valuable natural resources. It provides water for drinking, farming, industry, transportation, and many daily activities. Millions of people depend on it every day, which is why protecting it is extremely important. However, pollution has become a growing threat to the river. Plastic bags, bottles, food containers, and other waste (5) are sometimes thrown into the water. This pollution can harm fish, birds, and other living creatures. It can also make water treatment more difficult and expensive.
A group of secondary-school students decided that they could not ignore this problem. They formed an environmental club called "Friends of the Nile". The club meets every week to plan activities that can protect the river. Once a month, the students organize a clean-up (10) campaign near the Nile. They collect rubbish, separate recyclable materials, and put them into special recycling bins. They also design posters that encourage people not to throw waste into the river.
In addition, the students visit primary schools and speak to younger children about the dangers of pollution. They explain that small actions, such as using reusable bags and (15) putting rubbish in bins, can make a big difference. Their work soon attracted the attention of local businesses. Some companies began providing gloves, rubbish bags, and recycling bins for the campaigns. A local café also stopped giving plastic straws to customers unless they asked for them.
The students believe that protecting the Nile is a shared responsibility. They do not think (20) young people should wait for adults or governments to solve every problem. Instead, they believe that everyone should take practical action. Their example shows that even small groups can create positive change when they work together.

3 Read the following passage, then answer the questions:
For many years, the city of Al-Nour depended mainly on diesel generators to produce electricity. These generators provided power for homes, schools, hospitals, and shops, but they also caused serious environmental problems. Thick smoke rose into the air every day, making the city less pleasant and increasing air pollution. Doctors noticed that respiratory
(5) illnesses, such as asthma and breathing difficulties, were becoming more common, especially among children and elderly people. In addition, the price of fuel increased regularly, so electricity became expensive for many families.

As the population grew, the local government realized that it needed a safer and more sustainable solution. Therefore, it started a large renewable-energy project. Solar panels
(10) were installed on the roofs of schools, hospitals, and government buildings. A wind farm was also built outside the city, where strong winds could generate electricity for many hours each day. At first, some citizens doubted the project because they believed that the equipment would cost too much. However, engineers explained that renewable energy would save money in the long term because sunlight and wind are free natural resources.
(15) Within three years, Al-Nour reduced its dependence on fossil fuels significantly. Public buildings paid lower electricity bills, and the air became cleaner. The project also created jobs for engineers, technicians, electricians, and maintenance workers. Moreover, schools began teaching students about saving energy and protecting the environment. Many students started switching off lights, using less water, and encouraging their families to
(20) avoid wasting electricity.
Today, Al-Nour is seen as an example for other cities. Its experience proves that clean energy can protect the environment, improve public health, reduce costs, and create new opportunities for young people.
